append_only_convention: one result per run id under results/evaluation/coverage_remediation_crosscheck/<run_id>.json; reports follow reports/evaluation/COVERAGE_REMEDIATION_CROSSCHECK_<run_id>.md; a re-measurement is a NEW artifact under a NEW run id
freeze_history_note: Single freeze. Hypothesis, instrument and these pins are committed freeze-first BEFORE the first claim-bearing execution. No prior run of this instrument exists.
fresh_replay_protocol: hardlink-copy (cp -al, fallback cp -a) the accepted product mount to an evaluation-owned scratch directory under /tmp/opencode; run the shipped product/coverage_replay.py --mode offline there so every write lands in the scratch tree and the accepted mount is never written; copy only the produced JSON back into results/evaluation/coverage_remediation_crosscheck/ as the fresh-replay artifact of this run
network_policy: offline mode only; any network call is a V2 gate failure
